title: One Command Gives Claude Code a Permanent Memory (Never Re-Explain Your Project Again)
description:
Every time you close a Claude Code session, it forgets everything. Your project. Your bugs. Your setup. Gone.

Someone just built the fix. It's called Agent Memory.

Here's what it does:

🧠 Saves everything automatically — tool use, edits, tests, and errors logged in the background without you doing a thing

🔍 Searchable memory — ask about a database issue and it actually remembers the fix you made three weeks ago

💰 Way fewer tokens than dumping everything into the chat every session

🔒 Auto-hides your API keys and secrets before saving anything

♻️ Self-updating — old memories get replaced when new ones come in so your AI never gets confused with outdated info

✅ Works with Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, Windsurf, and any MCP tool simultaneously

Install it with one command:

npx agent-memory

That's it. Every new session starts already knowing your project.

Comment "memory" and I'll DM you the link 👇
